title: RNAseq of PBMC from HIDS patients
description: The aim of this study was to understand why two siblings carrying both the same homozygous causal mutation for the auto-inflammatory disease hyper IgD syndrome show opposite phenotypes, i.e. the first being asymptomatic, the second presenting all classical characteristics of the disease.

samples.title: VPER_lps3h37_1
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) were isolated by density gradient centrifugation from blood samples of VPER and VRIS using Ficoll-Paque™. PBMC cells (106 cells) were seeded in 24-well plates in RPMI1640 supplemented with fetal calf serum (FCS), penicillin, streptomycin, amphotericin B (all from Invitrogen) and stimulated with LPS (1 µg/mL; from Salmonella Abortus equi ; Sigma, Saint-Quentin-Fallavier, France) for 3 h or 6 h at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2. The control condition without LPS stimulation is named mi. Description of the sample naming: lps: stimualtion with lps - mi: no stimulation - 3h/6h: lps stimulation for 3 or 6 hours - _1 or _2: replicate 1 or 2 - VPER: subject VPER - VRIS: subject VRIS Trizol SOLiD Total RNA-Seq Kit
